_doc: Terminal launch profiles for the ttyd bridge. Edit ports/cwd/mode to taste. The 'host' field is what the dashboard URL will point to (typically the Tailscale DNS name of the device running this dashboard). bindInterface controls what NIC ttyd listens on — keep it 'tailscale0' in production. APPROVED_ROOTS in terminal-services.js gates which cwds are allowed; widen there if you need new directories. See docs/TERMINAL-BRIDGE.md.

terminalServices._comment_hermes: Moved off 7681 — Jerry has a long-running ttyd there (nyro:hello123, started May 4). 7685 is free. Lifecycle is persistent so reconnects work.
terminalServices.name: Hermes Skills Terminal

terminalServices._comment_claude: Was readonly+single-use which makes ttyd exit after the first browser disconnects (-o flag). Switched to persistent so reconnects work; kept readonly so it remains a watch-only viewer by default.
terminalServices.name: Claude Agent Terminal
